description: This Java class 'FilePathUtils' provides utility methods for constructing various URL and file path strings used throughout a web-based e-commerce application, including paths for static files, downloads, store URIs, customer URIs, admin URIs, and product/category URLs. It interacts with store configuration, request/session data, and constants to generate dynamic URLs.

classes.name: FilePathUtils
classes.description: Utility class for constructing URLs and file paths related to stores, products, downloads, and customer access within the web application.

methods.name: buildStaticFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for static content, such as images, based on store code and image name.

methods.name: buildAdminDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Creates a file path for administrative downloads of a digital product for a store.

methods.name: buildOrderDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Generates a URL for downloading a product related to a specific order, including order ID and product ID.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Builds the base URI for the store, considering request context and store domain.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Builds the store's URI using a provided context path, considering scheme and store domain.

methods.name: buildCustomerUri
methods.description: Constructs the customer's dashboard URL for the store.

methods.name: buildAdminUri
methods.description: Creates the admin section URI of the store based on current request and store configuration.

methods.name: buildCategoryUrl
methods.description: Builds the URL for a specific product category within the store.

methods.name: buildProductUrl
methods.description: Builds the URL for a specific product within the store.
